title: The colimit of an inverse system of sites with finite coverings
statement: Let $\mathcal I$ be a cofiltered category; for $i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal I)$ let $\mathcal C_i$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] all of whose coverings have finite index sets; for $a:i\to j$ in $\mathcal I$ let $f_a:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C_j$ be a morphism of sites given by a continuous functor $u_a:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$, with $f_a\circ f_b=f_c$ (i.e. $u_b\circ u_a=u_c$) whenever $c=a\circ b$ (Stacks Sites, Situation 0A34). Let $\mathcal C=\varinjlim\mathcal C_i$ be the category with $\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)=\varinjlim\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C_i)$ and $\operatorname{Arrows}(\mathcal C)=\varinjlim\operatorname{Arrows}(\mathcal C_i)$ (filtered colimits of sets along the maps induced by the $u_a$), with source, target and composition inherited, and $u_i:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C$ the canonical functors; let $\operatorname{Cov}(\mathcal C)$ be the union of the images under the $u_i$ of the sets $\operatorname{Cov}(\mathcal C_i)$. Then: (1) $(\mathcal C,\operatorname{Cov}(\mathcal C))$ is a site, and every finite diagram in $\mathcal C$ is the image under some $u_i$ of a diagram in $\mathcal C_i$ (Sites, Lemma 09YL). (2) Each $u_i$ is continuous and defines a morphism of sites $f_i:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C_i$, with $f_j\circ f_a=f_i$ for $a:j\to i$ (as $u_a$ followed by $u_j$ is $u_i$); for $U_i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C_i)$ and a sheaf $\mathcal F$ on $\mathcal C_i$, $f_i^{-1}\mathcal F(u_i(U_i))=\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}f_a^{-1}\mathcal F(u_a(U_i))$ (Sites, Lemma 0A35).
